item.title: Magnitude launches self-tuning inference engine for local agents
item.description: Magnitude’s open-source desktop engine tunes kernels to users’ hardware and connects local open models to agents including Pi, OpenCode, Hermes, and Codex; its developers claim up to 2× speed versus llama.cpp.

item.title: Pi adds MCP support to its core
item.description: Pi’s developers say they integrated MCP into the harness, using a JavaScript sandbox and configurable deferred tools to improve how agents discover and compose tool calls.

item.title: Strata launches governed semantic layer with agents grounded in live data
item.description: Strata says its semantic layer validates queries against governed warehouse models and provides agents with live measures, dimensions, and row-level security.

item.title: Opus 5.5 drift benchmark is still collecting baseline data
item.description: The benchmark has completed seven of 30 planned daily runs and has not yet produced a post-launch comparison; its creator says results are not expected until after day 20.
